item.title: [IBT] GTA 6 Release Day Set To Cost America $1 Billion With 1.5 Million Workers Plotting a Mass Sick Day
item.author: invalid@example.com (dex3108)
item.dc:creator: dex3108
item.content:encoded: Around 1.5 million Americans plan to skip work when Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on 19 November, a mass sick day one economist estimates could drain roughly $1 billion (£740 million) from US output in a single day. The estimate comes from José García Montalvo, an economics professor at Pompeu Fabra University in Barcelona. His figure is an academic projection rather than an official forecast, but the reasoning is simple. People need time to play it. Click to expand... Click to shrink... The Math Behind the... item.title: Games You Heard About, Thought You Knew What it Was, but When You Actually Saw It Properly, You Were Completely Surprised By What it Was
item.author: invalid@example.com (Derbel McDillet)
item.dc:creator: Derbel McDillet
item.content:encoded: So I just saw Deadlock for the first time properly today. That, is not what was in my head for the past 6 months. I thought it was something a lot more grounded looking and less Team Fortress 2 x Arkane. Now I'm wondering how I got that impression in the first place. So for me that was a lesson in not assuming you know when you don't. Has that ever happened to you for something else?
